Product Features

  • Size and shape: 65 x 65 x 38.5 cm, square shape, narrow in the middle and wide at the top and bottom, suitable for small and medium-sized living rooms. It doesn't take up any space and has its own sense of design. Placed in front of the sofa, it looks simple and neat.
  • High Gloss Material: The top and sides of the desk are made of high gloss material, fingerprints and water stains can be wiped off, and daily cleaning is easy; The black appearance is simple and versatile, matching modern, bright and luxurious living rooms and enhancing the luxurious feel of the space. (The highlight position is limited to the top and surroundings of the desktop.)
  • Liftable Table Top: The table top can be raised to 52.5cm and can be turned into a temporary dining table or office desk when raised, so you don't have to bend over when eating or working; It can be lowered and takes on the shape of a coffee table again. This allows you to drink tea or watch TV series more comfortably and switch seamlessly between multiple scenes.
  • Hidden Storage: There is hidden storage space under the tabletop, which does not interfere with lifting or lowering, and the remote control and snacks can be easily stored. Double drawers on either side can be used to store categorized books and game controllers, and the living room bids farewell to clutter.
  • APP atmosphere light: The mobile phone controls the LED light strip, sets the light to warm for watching movies and colorful for gatherings. Use light and shadow to change the style of the living room and the small coffee table will become an "atmosphere maker" that will enhance the style of the room.
  • Adapting to Multiple Scenes: Lifting + Storage + Mood Lighting, covering scenes such as food, office, gatherings, and watching movies. A coffee table takes over the core functions of the living room and is a "spacesaver" for small apartments.
  • Structural stability: The construction is narrow in the middle and wide at the top and bottom. The center of gravity remains stable when lifting. It is equipped with a sturdy bracket that can reliably support the weight. Food and computers can be easily placed on it and it will not deform even after prolonged use.
  • Material and Texture: The high-gloss tabletop is easy to clean and fingerprints and water stains can be wiped off. The black look is simple and versatile, fits modern and bright luxury living rooms and looks high-quality when placed in front of the sofa. It is made of chipboard and the recommended total load capacity is 30 kg
  • Entertainment Center Features: Hidden storage for board games and controllers, the tabletop can be folded up to serve as a gaming table, and it can instantly become a "core area of entertainment" at gatherings, so you don't have to worry about where to play when friends come over.
  • Efficient use of space: With a square area of 65cm, through the hub and storage expansion functions, a 1m² room can realize the 5-in-1 package of "coffee table + dining table + desk + storage cabinet + mood light", maximizing the efficiency of small living rooms.

Descriptions

Description

Overall size: 65 x 65 x 38.5 cm, a liftable coffee table for the living room, the tabletop can be raised and lowered to 52.5 cm in the highest position, a high-gloss coffee table (the high-gloss position is limited to the top of the tabletop and a circle around it), with hidden storage space under the tabletop, a drawer on each side, a total of two drawers, a square tabletop, narrow in the middle and wide at the top and bottom, equipped with an LED light strip controlled by a mobile phone app to create a living room atmosphere, a practical coffee table that integrates storage and lifting functions, an entertainment center, an atmosphere artifact, suitable for many scenarios such as office, dining room and gatherings.
